# TrendyCatch

> TrendyCatch sells clever, problem-solving everyday gadgets (home, kitchen, personal care and travel items) with free shipping to Australia, New Zealand, the United States and Canada.

TrendyCatch is a single-page storefront. Products, prices and variants are listed on the homepage and are also available as structured data.

## Key pages
- [Homepage and product catalog](https://trendycatch.us/)
- [Product data (JSON)](https://trendycatch.us/products.json)

## Policies

- [Refund Policy](https://trendycatch.us/refund-policy.html)
